rationale: Ground truth carries no substantive concerns (just bot rate-limit spam and a 'thanks'), so recall is vacuously satisfied by both. Both independently and correctly catch the CI-deselection bug (missing pytestmark) with concrete fixes, and both flag the sm_110a gap between the PR's own tcgen05 rationale and the ==10 gate — but X resolves it with a sharper technical explanation (GemmSm100.arch=100) while Y just asks for confirmation. X pulls ahead by surfacing two additional, well-grounded, high-value bugs Y misses entirely (warmup_quack_fp8 bypassing the gate, and warning_once's exception-identity keying defeating dedup), backed by live pytest verification, whereas several of Y's extra items (naming validation, 'blast radius' restatement) are lower-value observations rather than new defects.
